title: Patellofemoral Arthritis

positions.as_written: Take the history: pain on stairs and on rising from a chair, worse going down than up, with stiffness after sitting.
Assess the patellar facets by displacement and palpation, noting diffuse rather than focal tenderness.
Assess the painful arc, with and without patellar compression, and note crepitus felt under the hand as the knee moves.
Assess the tibiofemoral compartments, the joint lines and the alignment, since isolated patellofemoral arthritis is less common than the combined pattern.
Assess the range and the quadriceps, which are what limit the patient functionally.
